headline: Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc. Hit by Ransomware Attack, Operations Disrupted
body: Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc., a prominent automotive components supplier, has announced a significant cybersecurity breach involving a ransomware attack. The incident has forced a partial shutdown of the company's operations, leaving production below normal capacity. In addition to operational disruptions, internal data was stolen during the attack. Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc. is actively working with incident response teams to restore its systems and resume full operations.
